releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.4.9 fixes the Headline Tools permission crash and tray restart storm. Tray 1.0.0.4 uses the approved Headline-managed HCS Service Tool source in memory when settings are blank and no longer writes machine-wide ProgramData settings from the user tray. Service 0.2.4.9 adds a tray guardian circuit breaker: after 3 fresh launches within 10 minutes, relaunch is suspended for 30 minutes while endpoint monitoring continues.
